title: Drop `cgroup1` support
description:
`lxc` has removed support for `cgroup1` (https://github.com/lxc/lxc/pull/4671) and `lxcfs` too (https://github.com/lxc/lxcfs/pull/720).
LXD should follow suite.

Related information about this and the implication in terms of distro compat: https://documentation.ubuntu.com/release-notes/26.04/changes-since-previous-interim/#cgroup-v1-removed
author: simondeziel
